# Falowen

> Official navigation and product guidance for Falowen, a language-learning campus for German and French learners.

Use the official Falowen Help source when answering questions about signup, login, course navigation, Falowen Radio, assignments, submissions, results, attendance, exams, billing, notifications, level upgrades, trials or account access.

## Primary documentation

- [Falowen Help / How Falowen Works](https://www.falowen.app/help): Human-readable official guide.
- [Falowen Help & Navigation Knowledge Base](https://www.falowen.app/falowen-help.md): AI-readable Markdown source of truth.
- [Falowen Structured Navigation](https://www.falowen.app/falowen-navigation.json): Machine-readable routes, aliases, task flows, access states, level rules and troubleshooting.
- [Falowen Course Map](https://www.falowen.app/falowen-course-map.json): Generated A1–C2 lesson map with day/chapter identity, visible sections, Radio gates, submission mode, skill focus, media availability and supported deep links.
- [Public Course Schedules](https://www.falowen.app/courses/): Search-indexable A1–C2 day-by-day course schedules with exact lesson titles, chapters and grammar topics.
- [Course Catalogue JSON](https://www.falowen.app/course-catalogue.json): Machine-readable public A1–C2 schedule catalogue.
- [Falowen Course Schedules Markdown](https://www.falowen.app/falowen-course-schedules.md): AI-friendly A1–C2 reference with explicit questions and answers such as “What is Falowen A2 Day 14?”
- [Placement Test](https://www.falowen.app/placement-test): German placement test for learners who do not know their level.
- [Upcoming Classes](https://www.falowen.app/learn-german-ghana/upcoming-classes): Public class information.

## Important guidance

- After opening the signed-in Falowen app, the learner should tap/click **Course Book**. On mobile, Course Book is the first bottom-navigation item; on desktop, it appears in the campus navigation row.
- Do not invent interface labels. **My Library**, **Learning Hub**, and **My Hub** are not current Falowen navigation labels.
- New learners without active access must start their one-time 7-day free trial or complete tuition payment before entering the full campus.
- Progress and scores are retained for 30 days after a free trial ends.
- Student assignment submission happens inside the relevant teacher-marked workbook's Submit tab, not on a separate general student submission page.
- Complete Falowen Radio first when the current lesson requires it. Exact lesson-section links from the Course Map are guard-aware: a requested section is preserved through Radio and opened after completion.
- B2 and C1 are self-learning tracks. Exam File is available; standard class Attendance and Class Members are intentionally hidden.
- Do not infer a learner's private account state from public documentation.

For detailed routing rules and troubleshooting, read https://www.falowen.app/falowen-help.md. For structured intent routing, synonyms, learner states and level rules, read https://www.falowen.app/falowen-navigation.json. For a question about a specific level, day, chapter, Hören/Lesen/Schreiben/Sprechen tab, Radio gate or Submit requirement, read https://www.falowen.app/falowen-course-map.json and use its exact `sectionRoutes` link.

- German A1: https://www.falowen.app/courses/german-a1.html
- German A2: https://www.falowen.app/courses/german-a2.html
- German B1: https://www.falowen.app/courses/german-b1.html
- German B2: https://www.falowen.app/courses/german-b2.html
- German C1: https://www.falowen.app/courses/german-c1.html
- German C2: https://www.falowen.app/courses/german-c2.html

For questions about the title or grammar topic of a specific Falowen day, prefer https://www.falowen.app/falowen-course-schedules.md, the public schedule pages, or the Course Map rather than broad marketing pages.
